LESSON: READING 14.2.1 STUDY SKILLS

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 8
Subject: ENGLISH FOR LEARNERS WITH PHYSICAL IMPAIRMENT
Strand: Strand 14
Topic 14.2: Reading 14.2.1 Study Skills
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading 14.2.1 Study Skills, part of Strand 14 in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 8 ENGLISH FOR LEARNERS WITH PHYSICAL IMPAIRMENT.

Key inquiry question: Why is it important to summarise information? 2. How can key points be identified in a text?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading 14.2.1 Study Skills together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Learning to learn is achieved as the learner engages in self-driven tasks by displaying their paragraphs for peer review.

• Self-efficacy is enhanced as the learner identifies what they find confusing while making notes and writing summaries.

Values:
Unity is fostered as learners collaborates with peers to identify main ideas brought out in texts.

126

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs)

Safety is promoted as the learner reads a text on safety in sports and identifies key points.
